gold.Description: Gold is Esperia's common currency. Use gold to enhance your gear and level up your heroes.

diamond.Description: Diamonds are a valuable currency that have many uses.

diamond_charge.Description: Diamonds are a valuable currency that have many uses.

hero_exp.Description: Hero EXP is crucial for leveling up your heroes. You can use it in the hero menu.

servant_coin.Description: Hero Coins: Can be acquired by retiring heroes at the Rickety Cart, and are used at the Barracks to purchase heroes.

exp.Description: Used to increase your account level.

guild_coin.Description: Guild Coin: Can be acquired from guilds and used to purchase items in the Guild Store.

maze_coin.Description: Labyrinth Tokens are found within the Arcane Labyrinth and can be used at the Labyrinth store.

vip_exp.Description: VIP Experience is used to increase your VIP level and unlock many kinds of perks.

jade.Description: You can exchange 100 Tavern Tokens at the Tavern for a random Elite hero of your preferred faction!

friend_coin.Description: Can be used at the Tavern to buy heroes.

pentagram_coin.Description: Used to unlock slots at the Resonating Crystal. Available at AFK Rewards after clearing Chapter 5.

top_arena_coin.Description: Can be acquired from the Arena of Heroes and exchanged for rewards in the Arena Store.

champion_glory_exp.Description: Competitors will receive League Points at the end of seasons. Unlock more rewards by earning more League Points.

astrolabe_coin.Description: A powerful and divine object. Flawless Droplets may be acquired by Ascending Elite heroes up to higher Ascension tiers.

slg_coin.Description: Blessed Essence: A special essence produced by liberated tiles in the Vault of Time. Can be combined into Blessed Relics.

achievement_point.Description: Complete game achievements to acquire Achievement Points

homeland_coin.Description: Poe Coins: The main form of currency used at the Oak Inn

ruby.Description: Dragon Crystal: A currency that can be used in the Trading Hub at the Global Auction and Militia Trading.

bind_ruby.Description: Bound Dragon Crystal: A currency that is found in Militia Chests that can be exchanged at the Trading Hub's "Exchange Store" for items.

ruby_charge.Description: Dragon Crystal: A currency that can be used in the Trading Hub at the Global Auction and Militia Trading.

gve_coin.Description: These clusters of arrowheads represent the achievements of Hunters and are recognized as a kind of currency in the Hunting Fields.

crystal_coin.Description: A testament of one's devotion to the goddess and her outstanding contribution to the Temple of Light. This shard can be exchanged at the Crystal Vault for treasures of the Temple.

wish_coin.Description: A primitive stone token that has the symbol of the Yuexi Spring etched on it. Wilder legend says throwing magical stone tokens into the spring will allow for one's wishes to be realized.

pet_coin.Description: A special permit issued by the Beast Research Institute. Holders are authorized to capture beasts in their habitats.

race_coin.Description: A mysterious currency acquired in the Nightmare Corridor that can be exchanged for rewards in the Dream Store.

rog_coin.Description: The Badge of Valor awarded to warriors depending on their progress in Temporal Rift. Can be exchanged for other rewards at the Award Swap Section.

pet_mix_coin.Description: Beast Token: obtained by retiring extra beasts after Combining Beasts. Use it to exchange for rewards in the Beast Store.

monthly_card_exp.Description: Earned by purchasing the Deluxe Monthly Card, used to level up the Deluxe Monthly Card Perk Store.

monster_coin.Description: A currency that circulates in the magical realm, used to purchase gear at the Supply Depot. Obtained by passing Executive Alignments and Performance Evaluations.

war_conch.Description: Tide Shells: Seashells that contain a mysterious power, used as the exclusive currency of Goldsand Province. Obtained from the Vault of Riches, first city occupations, and Arms Mobilization. Used to activate Spirit Powers and mobilize arms. Can also be exchanged for rewards at the Spirit Shop.

war_army.Description: Army Units: With the Goldsand Province now open, elite fighters from across the world are gathering in search of a place to belong. They long to stand among the strong and help you accomplish a great cause.
